display.purpose: Player-facing menu, selection, outcome, Settings, pause, and dialog declarations/actions implemented in Unity. Chat uses Archivo only for short actions; dense utility and HUD combat readouts remain readable sans or quiet utility mono.

label.purpose: Short useful status, roster-role, binding, and technical metadata; ordinary sans remains preferred for dense Settings, chat messages, and HUD readouts.

motion.name: button-state

motion.name: hud-feedback

narrative.northStar: Low-poly underground toy-fight-club, with DIY internet-game energy
narrative.overview: Scavenged low-poly fight-club forms and curated asset-pack collage. Cool first, joke second; slightly crappy on purpose, extremely readable. Frontend pages are paper-led using the user-authored FrontendPaperBackground.png, continuing behind the transparent top bar with readable control-local paper backing and ink borders. Separate ink foreground/dark-field roles remain. Home has left modes, a larger aspect-fitted framed poster at center, and right announcements. Chat is an absolute user-sized bottom-left overlay with paper frame/tabs and grouped Hide/Resize, no maximize; dimensions never rebalance underlying layout. Fighter/stage participants and Player/CPU controls sit bottom middle/right, leaving bottom-left clear by default. Settings uses paper outer framing/categories and calm dark utility fields. Match overlays/HUD retain restrained neutral fields and independent functional colors. No 3D arena, gameplay, transport, creator/Ability Lab, or website redesign; connected-room acceptance remains unverified.
keyCharacteristics: Underground fight-club energy with DIY internet-game construction.
Chunky low-poly silhouettes and curated asset-pack collage, harmonized through scale, lighting, material response, palette/value hierarchy, and composition rather than a universal shader.
Archivo Black target name mark and display voice; readable utility typography.
Recognizable character forms and gameplay-readable silhouettes.
Dry self-aware copy that never obscures status.

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: Action Yellow (#FFCC22) and retained local orange may both exist on a screen, but one accent owns each region.

rules.name: The Hard Edge Rule
rules.body: Use borders, offsets, and layers before blur, glow, or ambient shadow.

rules.name: The Declaration Rule
rules.body: Give each composition one loud phrase. Supporting labels are smaller, quieter, and useful.

dos: Do establish the grid before adding crooked poster gestures.
Do make focus, selected, disabled, and confirmation states more obvious than texture.
Do keep gameplay HUD texture restrained and information stable.
donts: Don't use rounded cards, glassmorphism, soft ambient shadows, or glossy gradients by default.
Don't rotate dense information or required actions.
Don't use color as the only status indicator.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Action Yellow, square, bordered, and physically pressable.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background:#FFCC22; color:#17131B; border:2px solid #0D0D14; border-bottom-width:6px; padding:0 18px; min-height:56px; font-weight:700; letter-spacing:1px; text-transform:uppercase; } .ds-btn-primary:hover,.ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { background:#FFD95C; border-color:#F0EEE8; transform:translateY(-2px); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform:translateY(3px); }

components.name: Hot Button
components.description: Action Yellow primary field with a restrained Combat Orange impact edge for high-energy paths.
